name: python-index.json
description: Index of ai/scripts/python — retained Python utilities for SKF index traversal and frontmatter search

children.name: requirements.txt
children.description: Python package dependencies for the retained scripts (pyyaml)

children.name: common.py
children.description: Shared utilities used by the retained scripts: frontmatter parsing, JSON I/O, markdown parsing, and repository path resolution

children.name: resolve-skf-index-chain
children.description: Follows index pointer fields from the root index through nested indexes; supports optional branch filters and JSON output

children.name: get-skf-index-children
children.description: Parses a single index JSON file and returns a normalized children array; supports JSON output

children.name: validate-skf-index-targets
children.description: Classifies index target paths as file, folder, sub-index, or missing from JSON input; supports stdin or --input-file with JSON output

children.name: parse-navigation-result
children.description: Parses Navigation Result markdown and extracts domain groups or skill paths as table or JSON output

children.name: search-by-frontmatter
children.description: Searches framework markdown files by frontmatter fields with relevance scoring

children.name: create-plugin
children.description: Scaffolds a new plugin folder under ai/plugins/ (knowledge/, skills/, templates/ + index files) and registers the plugin in plugins-index.json

children.name: sync-index-files
children.description: Syncs all *-index.json files with actual filesystem state: adds new entries, removes stale ones, extracts deterministic frontmatter data, and preserves existing descriptions
